title: HTTP, MQTT, and protocol choice

spans.text: LESSON PURPOSE

Goal: apply “HTTP, MQTT, and protocol choice” to a real program or device. The key principle is: HTTP is request/response; MQTT is pub/sub. In a project, follow this guidance: Protocol QoS alone does not guarantee exactly-once business processing.
